wargearItems.name: Combat Drugs
effects: During your Command Phase, your unit can use Combat Drugs. To do so, select one of the following combat drug effects, which is in effect unit until the end of the Battle Round:
Gain the Feel No Pain 5+ ability

Alternatively, you can choose to expend 1 Pain token per combat drug effect and have up to all of the above combat drug effects in effect until the end of the Battle Round. However, when you do this, Weapons equipped by the unit gain the Hazardous 3 ability, or increase existing Hazardous [X] abilities by 3.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
During your Command Phase, your unit can use Combat Drugs. To do so, select one of the following combat drug effects, which is in effect unit until the end of the Battle Round:

  • Increase Movement characteristic by 2"
  • Increase Initiative characteristic by 2
  • Gain the Relentless ability
  • Gain the Fearless ability
  • Gain the Feel No Pain 5+ ability

Alternatively, you can choose to expend 1 Pain token per combat drug effect and have up to all of the above combat drug effects in effect until the end of the Battle Round. However, when you do this, Weapons equipped by the unit gain the Hazardous 3 ability, or increase existing Hazardous [X] abilities by 3.

wargearItems.name: Twin-linked
effects: For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1
The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Weapon gains the Twin-linked ability:

  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1

The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.
